تلتهمي (form VIII)
# تَلْتَهِمِي (taltahimī) /tal.ta.hi.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# تُلْتَهَمِي (tultahamī) /tul.ta.ha.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
